verdict.rationale: Jeeves marketing pages say you can invite team members, customize roles and permissions, and manage employee permissions (jeeves-docs-22, -37, -29, -6). Department-level scoping is only implied by 'departmental budget controls', which are a spend control rather than a permission scope. Missing for 10: documentation of how granular the permissions are, role scoping by location or department, detailed first-party admin docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
